sources.finding: Gould/Bonart find queue imbalance predictive of next midprice direction in ten Nasdaq stocks, stronger large tick. Does not establish delayed crypto trading profitability.

Cont/Kukanov/Stoikov study contemporaneous price impact of order-flow imbalance including adds/cancels/trades. This static queue diagnostic is different; contemporaneous impact does not establish a forward signal.
